CommunityApplications.Profile:
Parity Spot Check continuously verifies your array in the background: it picks a random sector offset, runs Unraid's own parity-check engine (mdcmd check nocorrect) over just that stretch, pauses, and repeats with a new random offset — indefinitely, until you turn it off. Always read-only (NOCORRECT); it never writes to parity and steps aside automatically if a real check or rebuild is already running. This repository contains the single Parity Spot Check plugin.
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/RayMunro/unraid-parity-spotcheck/issues
